test_title: PYST 44: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people P, R, S, T, U, V, and W are standing in a straight row facing North. R is standing second to the left of T. T is standing third to the left of W. R and S are not standing at either of the corners. U is the immediate neighbour of V. V is standing in the second position from the right corner. Who is standing to the immediate left of R?
solution:
Seven people P, R, S, T, U, V, and W are standing in a straight row facing North.

1) R is standing second to the left of T and T is standing third to the left of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf2a0d7e2249fd82ab0d977739a4e098674b5cc9f7138f461d0473a32d9f98b6.png] 

2) V is standing in the second position from the right
